title: YOU HEAR YOUR TEAMMATE FIRE
why: Found by the whole-game bug hunt of 2026-10-08. Your own gunshots, reloads and footsteps play straight into your own ears, and unlike every other sound they were never passed to the other window. So in co-op a teammate's rifle was silent at any distance (you saw only the tracers), and with the sound switched to one window only, the other player's whole fight made no sound at all. They are now passed on and play where he stands. A crouched step stays silent to others.
now: In co-op, you hear the other player fire, reload and walk, from where he is.

edits.replacement: if(fromPlayer) blipMine(melee?'hit':'shot',0,undefined,wep.id);   // v16.xx (H51): and the party hears it where you stand
